tracks.title: 彼台電視無歹去 Hit Tâi Tiān-sī Bô Phái--khì
tracks.mood: wry, hazy, a small tender ache in a quiet afternoon shop
tracks.subject: A Tainan TV-repair shopkeeper realises the old woman who carries in the same working CRT television every Thursday, swearing the picture is snowy, only wants a chair and her one channel of Taigi opera, so he pretends to tune it, and the week she skips he shoulders a set to her door.
